events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Hands-on maintenance clinic for all skill levels. Learn to handle skipping shifting, chain issues, rubbing brakes, and valve core breaks. Cost is $30. Rain or shine event. Dress in clothes you don't mind getting dirty. Bring your trail tools/kit. Check in 4:30-5pm. Drink token and small snack provided. For women 18 or older.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test + tune with Cane Creek Components experts. For riders with suspension bikes comfortable on rocky/rooty downhill trails. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. Bring riding clothes, pack, snacks, and water. No e-bikes allowed. First 8 emails to register get a spot. Email Dorene O'Malley to register. For women 18 or older. Preference given to those who haven't done a test + tune with Dirt Skrrts before.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Group ride in Pisgah and DuPont. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery (342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712). Neither location allows e-bikes. Must sign up through Eventbrite. For women 18 or older.

events.title: Volunteer Appreciation Party
events.description: Celebration for past volunteers. Prizes, giveaways, food, and one drink provided. No bikes needed. Partners welcome.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Group ride in Hot Springs. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing (25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231). This location does not allow e-bikes. Must sign up through Eventbrite. For women 18 or older.
